Job Description
 Who are we?
 At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.
 Join Vertiv’s new Finance Data & AI Analytics capability in Cluj-Napoca and help turn finance data into trusted, automated, decision-ready insight. The role combines financial analytics, BI reporting, data engineering concepts, process automation and practical AI/LLM usage. You will partner with Finance stakeholders to build scalable reporting, improve data quality, reduce manual work and accelerate insight generation across the organisation.
 Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain finance dashboards, KPIs and standardized reporting in Power BI, applying strong DAX and visualization practices.
Aggregate, interpret and summarize financial statistics; translate business questions into clear, decision-ready reporting and insights.
Develop and optimize SQL queries and data transformations; work with large datasets across source systems, databases and reporting platforms.
Automate recurring reporting and data workflows using Python, Power Automate and other RPA/automation tools, reducing manual effort and cycle time.
Contribute to governed data products and reusable datasets/models, with clear documentation, controls, validation routines and data-quality checks.
Support finance data movement and analytics workflows across on-premises environments and cloud platforms; collaborate on integrations and performance improvements.
Use LLMs responsibly for productivity and analytics tasks, including prompt engineering and review/correction of AI-generated reports and outputs.
Partner with Finance and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, communicate trade-offs and deliver scalable solutions; document processes and standard operating procedures.
Support exploratory AI/ML use cases such as anomaly detection, forecasting and intelligent automation as the Finance Data & AI Analytics capability matures.
 Qualifications & Experience
 CORE REQUIREMENTS
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
3+ years of experience in data analytics, BI, process automation, financial systems or related disciplines.
Strong working knowledge of Power BI and DAX; experience publishing reports and automating workflows.
Practical SQL skills and experience handling, transforming and validating large datasets.
Demonstrated experience with Python and automation/RPA tools for repeatable analytics or reporting processes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and process-improvement skills with high attention to detail and data quality.
 Preferred / Value-add
Experience with Snowflake and/or Oracle; familiarity with cloud data platforms and serverless services (AWS a plus).
Experience with HFM, Oracle EPM, OneStream, ERP data or FP&A / financial reporting processes.
Experience with Grafana, Tableau or Google Analytics in addition to Power BI.
Basic knowledge of Linux CLI, virtual machines, OAuth and authentication/authorization concepts.
Basic ability to interact with LLMs, prompt engineering, and critical review of AI-generated analysis.
General knowledge of financial metrics; manufacturing-sector finance knowledge is a plus.
Excellent communication skills and willingness to expand into adjacent data, cloud and IT domains.
